current_openings.title: Marketing Analytics Manager, North America
current_openings.team_structure: Reports to Head of Insights for North America; manages team of up to 4 analysts
key_responsibilities: Define the most important KPIs and lead the design/building of all performance reporting, tools, and analysis for the North America marketing function (CRM, paid media, organic)
Lead a team of (up to four) analysts, focusing on their development and influence with key stakeholders across performance marketing groups

Research and refine the approach to media attribution in line with Gymshark's go-to-market approach in North America, ultimately working towards true return on ad spend for as many marketing channels as possible
Enable test and learn approaches, partner with global data teams for data quality, and forecast marketing channel performance
required_skills: Minimum 5 years+ experience working in a marketing analytics / marketing science role reporting on and optimizing paid and owned media
At least 2 years of team management experience
Knowledge of CRM (ESPs, CDPs, etc.) and paid media platforms from a reporting and insights perspective

current_openings.title: Marketing Data Analyst
current_openings.location: Solihull, United Kingdom (Hybrid - minimum 3 days per week on-site)
key_responsibilities: Contributing to delivery of regular (weekly/monthly/quarterly) Marketing channel reports and updates to leadership
Gathering requirements for, building, and maintaining automated reports and dashboards relevant to key Marketing performance metrics
Working with the data team to improve access to data for reporting, automating data extracts and manual processes
Ensuring maintenance, cleanliness and readiness of key data sources, and aligning data sources and metric definitions
Develop in-depth knowledge of Gymshark's marketing data to support deep dive analytics across segmentation to optimize campaign and channel effectiveness
Design & support rigorous experiments to understand the impact of and optimize campaigns across channels
Reporting retrospectively on campaign and channel performance to provide clear insight into how marketing channels are performing against channel and business KPIs
Analyzing performance across paid marketing channels, including Paid Social and Paid Search
Analyzing email campaign performance and engagement across audiences
required_skills: Strong analyst background with experience in a data analyst role, ideally working with marketing data
Experience working with, manipulating and analyzing large, complex data sets
Ability to translate complex data sets into concrete business recommendations
Practiced in drawing conclusions from insights and presenting to stakeholders who may not be analytical-minded or data savvy
Experience automating repetitive tasks and reporting processes
Knowledge of media data measurement methodologies and industry standards including online and offline channels
Strong knowledge of marketing principles, strategies and digital media channels
required_tools: Tableau (or similar visualization tools like Power BI or Google Data Studio)
